unit: commit diffs per project per tick
note: BH-6892: on a lane-run machine (LANE_RUN_ID set) bin/pipeline-health.sh's stale-parent section reads commit diffs from GitHub REST (bin/lib/stale-parent-rest.sh) and reads at most this many uncached diffs per project per tick; the PRs past it keep their keys to the next tick, with one pipeline-health.log line. Read by spr_budget_init; a value outside 1..1000 is 120.
